Why Nod

Apps are becoming conversations. Wallets have to follow.

Approve every call

The agent stops at every checkout.

A paid API call or paying a friend back waits for you, so the AI is no longer doing the task.

Hand over the balance

A card or a key gives it everything.

No limit and no expiry, and nobody trusts an AI with the whole balance.

One allowance per AI app, on your own Stellar account. Inside it, it pays. Past it, your passkey. Nod's answer, in the chat where the AI already works: cards with MCP Apps, notices with MCP Events

Technical execution

The limit lives on your Stellar account.

Claude, ChatGPT, Goblin, any MCP appOAuth 2.1 with PKCE; tools, cards (MCP Apps) and events. A connection alone spends nothing.
Nod wallet serviceCloudflare Worker. Holds each app's key, reserves before signing, re-simulates in enforcing mode, pays every fee.
Your OpenZeppelin smart account
rule 0 · your passkey · admin and approvals

Circle USDCStellar Asset Contract, on mainnet and testnet
A 5.00 allowance spends exactly 5.00. One stroop more is rejected. c0f6f923 testnet, spike S1
An over-limit transfer forced onchain is rejected by the account itself. 3daf4b00 testnet, error #3221, spending limit exceeded
Past the allowance, the passkey signs the payment. The allowance is untouched. 0339b8dd mainnet, 5 USDC to Bob with a WebAuthn signature
Revoke removes the rule from the account and sweeps the pocket back. e17e15d5 mainnet; the sweep is ab6d493d
Nod pays every network fee. The owner holds 0 XLM. 0.001–0.05 XLM per payment on mainnet, relayer as source

Innovation

Four ideas behind Nod.

The pocket model

A smart account pays any x402 seller today.

Hosted facilitators reject smart accounts. Claude's key fills its own small account under the policy, in 1 USDC steps, then pays.

your account→ policy →pocket→ stock x402 client →facilitator
One number at connect

Connecting an AI app installs its allowance onchain.

The consent page asks one number and your passkey writes it to the account. One rule, expiry and revoke per app.

Ask, don't reject

Past the allowance, a passkey approval.

Most agent wallets just block it. Nod hands Claude a link, and your passkey signs that recipient and amount, on Nod's page, never in the chat.

Claim link

Pays people who have never held USDC.

Carol accepts once. The USDC contract's trust function and the transfer run in one transaction.

Market and ecosystem

Every AI app is a door.

Distribution through MCP

Any MCP app connects with one URL: Claude and Goblin today, ChatGPT as a developer-mode connector. Its app store bars crypto transfers for now.

Buyers for Stellar's x402 sellers

Stellar builders have shipped paid APIs and paid MCP tools. They need buyers whose owners will let them spend.

Every payment can onboard someone

Someone who has never held USDC gets a link and creates a wallet with a passkey. Past the allowance, the link is an allowance for that one person: exactly the amount, seven days, its key only in the link (live on testnet).

Live on mainnet

The full flow ran in claude.ai on the founder's own wallet. Open to anyone, USDC only: fund it from any exchange or wallet through a deposit address. A payment costs Nod 0.001–0.05 XLM.
